physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Crab Nebula is recorded: it is an extended nebula, and its package frames it at 1.317 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value.

sources.position: Pinned common ICRS image-frame origin derived from registered observations; adopted display centre, not a measured nebular centroid. (https://github.com/layoutit/css.earth/blob/main/labs/nebula/models/m1/observations.json); catalogue reference m1-registered-frame
sources.distance: Martin, Milisavljevic & Drissen (2021), 3D mapping of the Crab Nebula with SITELLE. I (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2101.02709v1); catalogue reference martin-2021: 2000 pc; Adopted 2 kpc reconstruction scale from Martin et al. (2021), section 3.4, following Trimble (1973). The cited 1.7–2.4 kpc range is not a statistical error. Lin et al. (2023) independently find 1.90 −0.18/+0.22 kpc; no distance refit is applied.
sources.properMotion: Zero: the nebula is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: Zero: SIMBAD lists no radial velocity for M 1 (queried 2026-10-01); the nebula is held at its catalogued distance.
